def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(j for row in grid for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
        objects.append((color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, shape))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    r0 = c0 = 0
    for i, (color, oh, ow, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        for dr, dc in shape:
            r, c = r0 + dr, c0 + dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                out[r][c] = color
        r0 += oh - 1
        c0 += ow - 1
    return out
